name: Aeey Choti Choti Baatein Pakadne Lag Gaya Tu Chotu
visual_description: Akshay Kumar pinching the cheek of a man in blue pajamas while talking, as an elderly man watches from a chair.
usage_context: Used to dismiss someone who is nitpicking minor errors, pointing out petty details, or taking trivial issues too seriously.

example.top_text: When friend points out a minor factual error in your exaggerated story

text_areas.description: Context or situation where someone points out minor flaws
